subject: Pause demo countdown while procurement completes
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@berylhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pause demo countdown while procurement completes

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the update on where things stand with procurement. I understand the vendor paperwork is in legal review and that the PO routing could take a little longer than expected. We don't want the proof-of-concept to stall out while that moves through your internal queues.

Two quick options that would keep your engineering team productive while procurement finishes:
- We can "pause" the demo countdown on our side until the PO is signed (no usage billed while paused).
- Alternatively, if you prefer keeping the timer live, we can provision a temporary 10k-token allotment for 7 days to allow continued benchmarking while paperwork completes.

If you confirm which you'd like, I'll get it applied immediately. Also attaching a brief MOU draft to make the vendor onboarding step smoother for your procurement team (MOU_Draft.pdf).

Would you like us to send a short note to Tina in procurement confirming Redwood will maintain access pending PO signature? If so, copy us and we'll send it.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MOU_Draft.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir@berylhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Gomez <tina.gomez@berylhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pause demo countdown while procurement completes

Avery —

Appreciate the proactive note. Legal pulled the vendor packet yesterday and told us the review will run ~7–10 business days due to contract language around data residency. Our procurement team can't issue a PO until that's cleared, unfortunately.

Keeping the demo live is important for the application team — they'd like to finish throughput runs this week. If you can pause the countdown, that would be ideal; otherwise the 10k temporary allotment sounds workable.

Yes, please do send a short confirmation to Tina that Redwood will hold/demo-pause or provide a temporary allotment while procurement finalizes. I will forward any PO number as soon as it routes.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Infrastructure, Beryl Health
samir@berylhealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@berylhealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pause demo countdown while procurement completes

Hi Samir —

Looping in Connor from our commercial ops team so we can turn this around quickly. We can do either of the options Avery suggested:

1) Demo pause: we freeze the trial timer and suspend billing for the account until we receive a signed PO. This preserves your current environment and all logs.
2) Temporary allotment: we grant a one-time 10,000 token sandbox credit valid for 7 days so your team can finish the runs.

Practical ask to apply either: please confirm the legal billing entity name and (if available) an expected PO number or procurement ticket id. Connor, are there any compliance ops notes you'd want added to the confirmation email to procurement?

I'll attach a short SOW outline to make vendor onboarding easier (SOW_outline.docx). If you'd prefer the pause, we'll send a formal hold-note to Tina and mark the account as "demo-paused — pending PO." If the allotment is preferred, we'll provision tokens immediately and share a brief usage dashboard.

Next steps: Samir, reply with "PAUSE" or "ALLOTMENT" and the billing entity. We'll take it from there.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_outline.docx

From: Samir Patel <samir@berylhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Gomez <tina.gomez@berylhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pause demo countdown while procurement completes

Camila / Avery —

Thanks — we'll go with the PAUSE option. Please mark the account as "demo-paused — pending PO" and send the short confirmation note to Tina (cc'd). Billing entity is: Beryl Health, Inc. Expected PO number will be provided by end of next week — legal aims to finish review by 23 June.

Tina, copying you here so procurement sees the plan from Redwood. If you need any additional paperwork from our side to keep the account live while legal reviews, let me know and I'll expedite.

Appreciate the quick help.

—Samir
